newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China Jan industrial output up 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China Jan industrial output up 13 pct.

text.p: China's industrial output value in January 1997 was expected to reach 152 billion yuan ($18.31 billion), officials said on Monday.
This would mark an increase of 13 percent compared with the same period of last year, an official of the State Economic and Trade Commission Information Centre said by telephone.
China's industrial output rose by 13.1 percent to 1.9062 trillion yuan in 1996 compared with the previous year.
